name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam grew up around engines; his dad ran a small garage in Christchurch. From a young age, he was fascinated by how things worked and spent hours tinkering with anything he could get his hands on. After completing his apprenticeship, Liam spent a few years working on restoring classic cars, which instilled in him a deep appreciation for precision and attention to detail. He transitioned to motorsport seeking a faster pace and a more competitive environment.

As a fabricator, Liam is meticulous and takes pride in producing high-quality work. He’s a fast learner and eager to expand his skillset, especially in areas like welding and composite materials. He is known to be a very reliable member of any pit crew.

Liam's background in classic car restoration gives him a unique perspective on problem-solving and improvisation. He’s not afraid to think outside the box to find solutions, and his calm demeanor makes him a valuable asset in high-pressure situations. He is loyal to a fault, and would never leave a team mid-season.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed hair with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is of average height, with a sturdy build and calloused hands from years of working with tools.

quirks: Always wears a worn-out leather wristband.
Hums quietly while concentrating on intricate tasks.
Insists on using specific brand of penetrating oil.
